name: Line Item 14
definition: Calculation of the current situation of a baseline as a result of the submission of a commercial data set.

LineItemDetails.name: Line Item Details
LineItemDetails.definition: Calculated information about the goods of the underlying transaction.

OrderedLineItemsTotalAmount.name: Ordered Line Items Total Amount
OrderedLineItemsTotalAmount.definition: Line items total amount as indicated in the baseline.

AcceptedLineItemsTotalAmount.name: Accepted Line Items Total Amount
AcceptedLineItemsTotalAmount.definition: Line items total amount accepted by a data set submission(s).

OutstandingLineItemsTotalAmount.name: Outstanding Line Items Total Amount
OutstandingLineItemsTotalAmount.definition: Difference between the ordered and the accepted line items total amount.

PendingLineItemsTotalAmount.name: Pending Line Items Total Amount
PendingLineItemsTotalAmount.definition: Line item total amount for which a mismatched data set has been submitted and has not yet been accepted or rejected.

OrderedTotalNetAmount.name: Ordered Total Net Amount
OrderedTotalNetAmount.definition: Total net amount as indicated in the baseline.

AcceptedTotalNetAmount.name: Accepted Total Net Amount
AcceptedTotalNetAmount.definition: Total net amount accepted by a data set submission.

OutstandingTotalNetAmount.name: Outstanding Total Net Amount
OutstandingTotalNetAmount.definition: Total net amount for which a mismatched data set has been submitted and has not yet been accepted or rejected.

PendingTotalNetAmount.name: Pending Total Net Amount
PendingTotalNetAmount.definition: Difference between the ordered and the accepted total net amount.
